Country and location: Panama, 18 km northeast of Cerro Punta
Notes: Two buildings were damaged. Some objects fell in supermarkets.[citation needed]

Country and location: South Africa, 7 km south southeast of Stilfontein
Notes: Plaster fell from walls and houses were slightly damaged in Orkney and Klerksdorp.

Country and location: Botswana, 132 km west southwest of Moiyabana
Notes: The 2017 Botswana earthquake was the strongest earthquake recorded in Botswana since 1952. Thirty-six students were injured in a stampede sparked by the quake.

Country and location: Philippines, 5 km west of Batangas City
Notes: 2017 Batangas earthquakes: The earthquake damaged houses in Batangas City and the Taal Basilica. Some power outages occurred in San Pascual. This was a foreshock of the 5.9 quake.

Country and location: Iran, 61 km north northwest of Torbat-e Jam
Notes: 40% of buildings have been ruined in four villages. Some houses and buildings were seriously damaged in Mashhad. Phone lines were disrupted. Two people were killed and 34 others injured.

Country and location: Greece, 1 km west southwest of Nafpaktos
Notes: Older buildings suffered minor damage, with bricks and stones falling into the streets below. A power outage occurred in the town of Rio.

Country and location: Philippines, 1 km north northwest of Talaga
Notes: 2017 Batangas earthquakes: Houses and buildings were damaged, landslides occurred at Mount Macolod and power outages were reported. Six people were injured. Around 14,000 people were temporarily relocated to evacuation centers.

Country and location: Albania, Lezhë, 8 km northeast of Rrëshen
Notes: Dozens of buildings were damaged and landslides occurred in the epicentral area.

Country and location: El Salvador, 4 km west southwest of Tonacatepeque
Notes: The earthquake damaged houses in Antiguo Cuscatlán and caused landslides as well as power failures in some areas. One person died and three others were injured when a falling rock hit their car on a highway.
About 500 homes and 2 mosques were damaged in Lanao del Sur. Power failures also occurred and cracks appeared on the national highway. One person was injured.

Country and location: Chile, 62 km southeast of San Pedro de Atacama
Chile offshore, 37 km west of Valparaíso
Notes: This was a foreshock of the 6.9 quake.

Country and location: Chile offshore, 40 km west of Valparaíso
Notes: 2017 Valparaiso earthquake: Santiago International Airport suffered light damage on floors and ceilings. A car was hit by a falling rock on a service road near a highway.
Several buildings were damaged and at least one house collapsed. Five people were injured.
